name: ak
description: The ak command, and ak setup, the kit's installer: it checks your machine, installs the plugins you pick, and takes a run back with ak setup undo. Its own verbs: plugin ls, inspect and log (what your plugins put in front of your agent) and hooks (which hook ran, when, how long); with the gateway, gateway, xray (the exact prompt a claude launch would send, as a dry run), sysprompt and shim. Every other kit plugin adds its verbs to it: the tracer's are ak sessions and ak trace. A uv tool, kept up to date when a session starts.

setup.summary: the ak command every other plugin plugs into
gives: ak — what is installed, and every verb the plugins below add
